faqs.question: How do project inquiries and the hiring process work?
faqs.answer: After you submit a project request via the Contact page or click "Hire Me", I review your project scope and respond within 24 hours (via Discord or Email). We align on goals, deliverables, timeline, and pricing. Once agreed, work begins with structured milestones and regular progress updates.

faqs.question: Can I manage website content, prices, and media myself after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes! That is one of my core engineering principles. Every website includes a private, intuitive Admin Panel where you can update hero titles, background videos/images, service descriptions, pricing plans, portfolio projects, customer feedback, and media without touching a line of code.

faqs.question: Do you work on existing Minecraft servers or only build from scratch?
faqs.answer: Both. I can diagnose, optimize, and add custom Skripts/plugins to your existing Paper/Purpur/Spigot server, or architect an entire new network from the ground up with proxies, database synchronization, and custom model data.

faqs.question: Can you host my custom Discord bot or do I host it myself?
faqs.answer: I provide full deployment setup on your own server or VPS (e.g. Linux, Docker, PM2) and guide you step-by-step. Alternatively, I can provide managed hosting recommendations so your bot runs 24/7 with 99.9% uptime.

faqs.question: What are your payment terms and accepted methods?
faqs.answer: Projects typically follow a milestone structure: 50% upfront to reserve the project slot and commence architecture, and 50% upon final completion and handover. I accept UPI, Bank Transfer, PayPal, and Crypto (USDT/BTC/ETH).

faqs.question: What happens if I need changes after the project is completed?
faqs.answer: All plans include dedicated post-launch support (between 14 to 45 days depending on the selected plan) for bug fixes, adjustments, and questions. Long-term ongoing maintenance retainers are also available.
